summary: Energy Recovery, Inc. disclosed on Form 8-K that CEO David Moon will retire after a successor is appointed, and CFO Mike Mancini resigned effective May 6, 2026, with no financial or accounting disagreements. Interim CFO Aidan Ryan was appointed. The filing reports Q1 2026 earnings but the material event is the simultaneous departure of two top executives. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendation are given. The transition is voluntary but abrupt; watch for a permanent CEO hire and any strategic shift under new leadership. No risk-arb angle.
